name: 1 · spring.md (OQ-SC2) — bean creation and wiring; re-check of approved LY6

items.title: Constructor injection only — SHARPEN (approved 2026-10-02, re-check)
items.rule: Spring beans take dependencies through one constructor; an optional or zero-or-more collaborator is an `ObjectProvider<T>` resolved at use, never a setter, a no-arg constructor or `@Autowired(required=false)`.
items.source: FW core/beans/dependencies/factory-collaborators.html §Constructor-based or setter-based DI (setters only for optional deps with defaults, 'Otherwise, not-null checks must be performed everywhere'); BOOT using/spring-beans-and-dependency-injection.html ('We generally recommend using constructor injection'); Drotbohm 'Why field injection is evil' (2013); pl 301 Ex 7. AP: 0 field injection in src/main; setter/optional Bad `GuardrailPipeline.java:43-50`, `PiiRedactor.java:46-57`, `MockResultResolver.java:42-49`.
items.recommend: AGREE, SHARPEN — current Good `AgentsAutoConfiguration.java:145` is wrong (@Lazy ObjectProvider resolved inside the factory); replace with `AgentToolHandler.java:40-43,122-123` or `ToolsAutoConfiguration.java:270-275`. Re-approve the text.
items.extra: Legend: BOOT = docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference (4.1.1) · FW = docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference (7.0.9) · pl 301 = jabrena-plinth 301 @5e338bb · SBS = rrezartprebreza/spring-boot-skills @f0c06a0 · AP = agent-platform origin/master @772736bf; `…/` = src/main/java/ai/aruvii/. Full notes: research/51-spring-core-rules.md.

items.title: Mark the Spring constructor when there are two
items.rule: Give a bean one constructor. When a test-only second constructor exists, put `@Autowired` on the one Spring uses; never on a single constructor.
items.source: FW core/aot.html §Avoid Multiple Constructors; BOOT using/spring-beans-and-dependency-injection.html. AP: correct at `RedisConsumerGroup.java:62`, `StreamBacklogJob.java:48`, `WebhookCallbackSender.java:35`, `LlmFakeGenerator.java:36`; redundant `PresidioNerClient.java:37`.
items.recommend: fold into LY6 — no separate id.
items.drop: fold: becomes part of LY6's Bad list / review check.

items.title: Cut dependency cycles; ObjectProvider only as a named cut
items.rule: A dependency cycle is a design error: cut it. If it cannot be cut, hold an `ObjectProvider<T>` field, resolve it at call time, and name the cycle in a comment.
items.source: FW factory-collaborators.html §Circular dependencies; FW core/aot.html §Avoid Circular Dependencies; BOOT property spring.main.allow-circular-references (default false). AP Good `AgentToolHandler.java:32-43,122-125` (names ChatOrchestrator → ToolService → AgentToolHandler → AgentChatPort); Bad `AgentsAutoConfiguration.java:142-148` (@Lazy ObjectProvider, getIfAvailable in factory, throwing stub).

items.title: No @Lazy on ObjectProvider, no global lazy init
items.rule: Never put `@Lazy` on an `ObjectProvider`, and never enable `spring.main.lazy-initialization`; laziness hides wiring failures until first use.
items.source: BOOT features/spring-application.html §Lazy Initialization ('can delay the discovery of a problem'); FW classpath-scanning.html (ObjectProvider recommended for lazy/optional). AP: `AgentsAutoConfiguration.java:145`, `ToolsAutoConfiguration.java:194`; global lazy off.

items.title: @Fallback for stand-ins, @Primary not to win races
items.rule: Two beans of one type: mark the real one `@Primary` only when both must exist; mark a stand-in default `@Fallback`. Never add `@Primary` to win a condition race.
items.source: FW core/beans/annotation-config/autowired-primary.html (@Primary, @Fallback since 6.2); Josh Long, spring.io blog 2024-11-24 'Bootiful Spring Boot 3.4: Spring Framework'. AP: @Primary added as the S5.6 fix (`.claude/SPRINTS.md:404`) on `GlobalTrustStore.java:38`, `JdbcSslAdapter.java:24`; `AgentsAutoConfiguration.java:78` vs default `ToolsAutoConfiguration.java:91-95`; legit composite `CompositeApprovalNotificationAdapter.java:17`.

items.title: Lite configuration classes
items.rule: Write every configuration class `@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)`; take collaborators as `@Bean` method parameters; never call another `@Bean` method.
items.source: FW core/beans/java/basic-concepts.html (lite mode: '@Bean methods … are not meant to declare inter-bean dependencies at all'); FW configuration-annotation.html; BOOT listings use it throughout; spring-boot#9068 (Phil Webb opened, Stéphane Nicoll design objection, Andy Wilkinson measured startup gain). AP: 24/24 @Configuration proxied; script found 0 inter-bean calls → switch is behaviour-neutral.

items.title: Most specific @Bean return type
items.rule: A `@Bean` method returns the most specific type it builds.
items.source: FW core/aot.html §Expose the Most Precise Bean Type; BOOT developing-auto-configuration.html §Bean Conditions. AP returns ports (`AgentsAutoConfiguration.java:53`).
items.drop: We run no AOT; every AP condition names its port type explicitly; returning the port is our hexagonal contract (LY2).

items.title: Replaceable defaults only where order is guaranteed
items.rule: A replaceable default bean (`@ConditionalOnMissingBean` stub) lives only where its evaluation order is guaranteed — mechanism per OQ-SC1.
items.source: BOOT features/developing-auto-configuration.html §Bean Conditions ('we recommend using only @ConditionalOnBean and @ConditionalOnMissingBean annotations on auto-configuration classes'), §Locating ('never the target of component scanning'). AP: 15 @ConditionalOnMissingBean on component-scanned @Configuration (both apps scan ai.aruvii); real incident S5.6 `.claude/SPRINTS.md:404` (fallbacks 'occasionally winning over the platform beans'); guard safety rests on it `NoAgentCountAdapter.java:15-21`.

items.title: @Enable* off the main class
items.rule: Put feature switches (`@EnableScheduling`, `@EnableAsync`, `@Enable*Auditing`) on a dedicated `@Configuration`, never on the `@SpringBootApplication` class.
items.source: BOOT testing/spring-boot-applications.html §User Configuration and Slicing; pl 301 Ex 1. AP Bad `AruviiWorkerApplication.java:9-11`; Good `JpaConfig.java:8-11`, `SecurityConfig.java:20-22`, `WorkerSchedulingConfig.java:13`.

items.title: Runner spec for every conditional bean
items.rule: Every conditional bean has an `ApplicationContextRunner` spec that proves both branches: it applies alone, and it backs off when the real bean is present.
items.source: BOOT developing-auto-configuration.html §Testing your Auto-configuration; SBS configuration-properties §Verification. AP: runner specs exist only for properties (`WorkerStreamsStartupSpec.groovy:16-49`, `OllamaNumPredictStartupSpec.groovy`); none for 15 defaults or 4 property conditions.
items.kind: gated (test) — testing rule that changes production wiring

items.title: Property conditions on aruvii.* kebab keys
items.rule: `@ConditionalOnProperty` names a kebab-case key under `aruvii.` and states `havingValue` and `matchIfMissing`.
items.source: BOOT developing-auto-configuration.html §Property Conditions, §Configuration keys ('use a unique namespace'); BOOT external-config.html (canonical form). AP Good `SingaporePiiPolicy.java:21`, `ActivityClassifier.java:44`; Bad `PresidioNerClient.java:25` ('NER_SERVICE_URL').

name: 3 · spring.md — configuration properties and environment; re-check of approved LY7

items.title: Grouped settings bind to a record — SHARPEN, raise from NIT (approved 2026-10-02, re-check)
items.rule: Grouped settings bind to one `@ConfigurationProperties` record that validates at startup; each key is bound in one place; `@Value` only for a single scalar no other class reads.
items.source: BOOT features/external-config.html §@ConfigurationProperties vs. @Value ('we recommend you group them in a POJO annotated with @ConfigurationProperties'), §Constructor Binding (records, @DefaultValue); pl 301 Ex 4, 11; SBS configuration-properties. AP: 3 records vs 34 @Value in src/main.
items.recommend: AGREE, SHARPEN — NIT too low: one key has two defaults (SC12). Replace Good `PlatformConfigProperties.java:7-9` (holds a secret, SC17) with `WorkerStreamsProperties.java:17-35`. Re-approve.
items.extra: Legend: BOOT = docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference (4.1.1) · FW = docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference (7.0.9) · pl 301 = jabrena-plinth 301 @5e338bb · SBS = rrezartprebreza/spring-boot-skills @f0c06a0 · AP = agent-platform origin/master @772736bf; `…/` = src/main/java/ai/aruvii/. Full notes: research/51-spring-core-rules.md.

items.title: Register records with @EnableConfigurationProperties
items.rule: Register a properties record with `@EnableConfigurationProperties` on the module's configuration class; never also as `@Component` or `@Bean`.
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §Constructor Binding ('You cannot use constructor binding with beans that are created by the regular Spring mechanisms'), §Enabling; SBS gotcha. AP Good `PlatformAutoConfiguration.java:14-15`, `OllamaChatConfig.java:6-7`, `WorkerStreamsConfig.java:28-29`.
items.recommend: adopt as review check only (AP complies; the trap is agent-made).

items.title: One owner per key
items.rule: A key read in two classes is a finding: move it into the owning record.
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §@ConfigurationProperties vs. @Value, §Default Values. AP: `aruvii.activity.ollama.timeout-ms` default 5000 `AdminActivityClient.java:46` vs 1500 `OllamaActivityClient.java:45` (+ `LlmFakeGenerator.java:38-39`); `aruvii.master-key` read 4 ways (`PlatformConfigProperties.java:9`, `ErasureConfig.java:16`, `ProvidersAutoConfiguration.java:32`, `ToolsAutoConfiguration.java:82`); `aruvii.eval.*` duplicated api/worker `EvalTimeoutsConfig.java:19-22`.
items.recommend: adopt — the measurable core of LY7.

items.title: Configuration only through binding or Environment
items.rule: Read configuration only through binding or the `Environment`: keys are kebab-case under `aruvii.`; never `System.getenv` or an env-var name in `@Value`.
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §Relaxed Binding, §Binding From Environment Variables, §Using Configuration Trees, @Value canonical-form note. AP Bad `System.getenv`: `SetupService.java:177,289`, `PlatformAutoConfiguration.java:31`, `WorkerLicenseBridgeConfig.java:41`; env names in @Value `HealthController.java:45-46`, `NerSidecarHealthIndicator.java:26`, `PresidioNerClient.java:38`.
items.recommend: adopt — System.getenv skips the configtree:/run/secrets/ import both apps declare and cannot be overridden in tests.

items.title: Duration/DataSize with units
items.rule: Times and sizes bind as `Duration`/`DataSize` with a unit in the value (`2s`), never a `long` named `*-ms`/`*-seconds`.
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §Converting Durations; BOOT developing-auto-configuration.html internal key rules ('Use Duration rather than long'); SBS ('explicit units'). AP Good `WorkerStreamsProperties.java:22`, `EvalTimeoutsConfig.java:19-22`; Bad `OllamaActivityClient.java:45`, `AdminActivityClient.java:46`, `RedisConsumerGroup.java:66`.

items.title: Fail startup on bad settings, prove it
items.rule: A settings record rejects bad values at startup with a message naming the key, and a runner spec proves it.
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §@ConfigurationProperties Validation; pl 301 Ex 11; SBS §Verification (@NotNull does not reject zero Duration). AP Good `WorkerStreamsProperties.java:26-35` + `WorkerStreamsStartupSpec.groovy:43-49`, `OllamaChatProperties.java:18-25`; none on `PlatformConfigProperties`.

items.title: No default secret or required endpoint
items.rule: No default for a secret or a required endpoint: absence fails startup, or selects a named degraded mode that logs once at WARN.
items.source: SBS configuration-properties ('missing credentials or required endpoints should fail startup'; gotcha 'adds a default credential'); BOOT silent. AP: `aruvii.master-key` empty default (`application.yml:104` api, `:72` worker) → `CredentialEncryptor.java:22-25` plaintext passthrough, silent; datasource password default `ARUVII_internal` (`application.yml:25` worker, `:18` api).
items.recommend: adopt; master-key behaviour decided in OQ-SC4.

items.title: No secret in a properties record
items.rule: Never make a secret a component of a `@ConfigurationProperties` record; record `toString` prints it.
items.source: SBS configuration-properties ('generated toString can expose secrets'). AP Bad `PlatformConfigProperties.java:9` masterKey.

items.title: @PostConstruct only checks state
items.rule: `@PostConstruct` only checks injected state or builds in-memory structures; no I/O, no calls into other beans, no thread or container start.
items.source: FW core/beans/factory-nature.html §Initialization Callbacks (singleton creation lock, 'risk for an initialization deadlock'); FW tx annotations (don't rely on proxies in @PostConstruct); BOOT spring-application.html §Readiness ('instead of … @PostConstruct'). AP Bad `GlobalTrustStore.java:56-59`, `ChatResponseSubscriber.java:44-48`, `RagIngestSubscriber.java:55-59`, `KafkaTriggerManager.java:59-62`, `JdbcSslAdapter.java:36-39`.

items.title: Runner before ready, listener hands off
items.rule: Startup work that must finish before traffic runs in an `ApplicationRunner`; work that may finish later is handed to another thread from `@EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent)`, which returns at once.
items.source: BOOT features/spring-application.html §Readiness State, §Application Events ('Event listeners should not run potentially lengthy tasks'), §Using the ApplicationRunner. Contradicts pl 301 Ex 3 Good. AP Good `AdminAutoSeeder.java:15`, `TrustUpgradeCheckJob.java:58-61`, `ChatStreamConsumer.java:63-68`.

items.title: Start/stop work is a SmartLifecycle bean
items.rule: A component that starts and stops background work (listener container, consumer loop) is a Spring-managed `SmartLifecycle` bean, not `new`-ed and started in `@PostConstruct`.
items.source: FW factory-nature.html §Startup and Shutdown Callbacks (phases, 30 s per phase); BOOT web/graceful-shutdown.html (earliest SmartLifecycle phase). AP Bad `ChatResponseSubscriber.java:38-53` (new RedisMessageListenerContainer driven by @PostConstruct/@PreDestroy). Decided edge: `WorkerDrain.java:18-30` uses ContextClosedEvent on purpose.
items.recommend: adopt with the WorkerDrain edge written down.

items.title: No self-invocation of proxied methods
items.rule: A proxied annotation works only on a call from another bean. Never call such a method through `this`; move it to a second bean. No self-injection, no `AopContext`.
items.source: FW core/aop/proxying.html §Understanding AOP Proxies ('self invocation … will bypass the advice'; refactor is 'the best approach'; AopContext 'highly discouraged'); FW data-access/transaction/declarative/annotations.html; FW autowired.html (self references 'last resort'); pl 301 Ex 2; SBS transactional-patterns. AP Bad `SetupService.java:174-179` → `getOrGenerateSecretKey` (@Transactional :165) called via this on the JwtService/OidcController path.

items.title: @Retryable outside the transaction
items.rule: Put `@Retryable` on a caller bean around the `@Transactional` call, never on the same method or bean.
items.source: SBS transactional-patterns (Framework 7 @EnableResilientMethods); FW proxying. AP: 0 @Retryable.
items.drop: No use in AP; CC8 (retry, group 12) owns retry; add with the first @Retryable.

items.title: How a module supplies a replaceable default
items.rule: Decide: real @AutoConfiguration + imports file (a), scanned @Configuration with @Fallback defaults (b), or status quo with @Primary winners (c)?
items.source: BOOT developing-auto-configuration.html; FW autowired-primary.html (@Fallback); Josh Long 2024-11-24; Hoeller Spring I/O 2024. AP: 8 `*AutoConfiguration` classes are scanned plain @Configuration; 15 order-dependent conditions; S5.6 bug.
items.recommend: (b) now + rename *AutoConfiguration → *Config; SC9 tests either way. Stubs that warn on construction (`NoAgentCountAdapter.java:29-33`) must warn on first use instead.
items.extra: Options: (a) documented mechanism, larger change (packaging + scan exclusion) · (b) one annotation per site, order-free, stub still instantiated · (c) keeps the race.

items.title: Home of the SC rules
items.rule: Decide: new `.agents/skills/code/references/spring.md` (LY6/LY7 move there), or append to services.md + layering.md?
items.source: research/00-reference-format.md (one file per topic, G5); group 10 header in review/g9b.json.
items.extra: Changes: appending ~15 container rules would double services.md and mix mechanics with service shape.

items.title: Profiles
items.rule: Decide: codify 'no @Profile, no application-<profile>.yml; environments differ by env vars/configtree; features by @ConditionalOnProperty'?
items.source: BOOT features/profiles.html; pl 301 Ex 6, 15 (Ex 15 warns profiles leak test doubles). AP: 0 @Profile, 0 profile files.

items.title: Empty master key → plaintext credentials
items.rule: Decide: is `CredentialEncryptor` passthrough on an empty `aruvii.master-key` an intended dev mode, or a bug?
items.source: AP `CredentialEncryptor.java:22-25`, `application.yml:104` (api), `:72` (worker); SBS gotcha 'adds a default credential'.
items.recommend: (a) explicit opt-in property, fail startup otherwise; route to security group 13 / #53.
items.extra: Options: (a) explicit `aruvii.credentials.plaintext-allowed=true` · (b) always fail · (c) keep. SC16 waits on this.

items.title: Validation style for settings records
items.rule: Decide: compact-constructor checks (AP), `@Validated` + Jakarta constraints (BOOT/pl 301/SBS), or either?
items.source: BOOT external-config.html §Validation; AP `WorkerStreamsProperties.java:26-35`, `OllamaChatProperties.java:18-25`.
items.recommend: either, compact constructor preferred; SC15 governs the outcome.

items.title: SC5 rollout
items.rule: Decide: proxyBeanMethods=false on new/touched classes only, or one sweep of all 24?
items.source: AP: 24 classes, 0 inter-bean calls (script).
items.recommend: one sweep, in the same MR as OQ-SC1 (b) — same files.
